verdict.description: fail only if a proven bug caused by this PR is still in the code. Otherwise pass.

summary.description: Short Markdown summary: what you checked, what you found, and what you could not check.

findings.description: New issues only. Issues already raised in an earlier thread go in thread_replies.

path.description: Repo-relative path of a file changed by the PR.

line.description: A line in the PR diff, in the new version of the file.

body.description: Markdown: what happens, who is affected, the proof, and a suggested fix.

proven.description: true only if a test or screenshot in the evidence directory shows it.

thread_replies.description: One reply for each unresolved earlier thread of yours.

resolved.description: true if the current code fixes the issue.
